plugins.name: agentic-verification
plugins.description: Agentic verification for Python/pytest. Verify a change: run every mutant of the changed lines and write tests until the tests catch them. Audit a suite: find what it would not catch, what makes it too slow or flaky for an agent loop, and which tests can go without losing detection.
